about: Legacy systems brought into Jarvis as offices (owner request Nov 23 2026). Each viable system has legacy_offices/offices/<slug>.json in the offices/TEMPLATE.json format plus a 'legacy' block (repo, stack, entry points, env NAMES, tests, dry run) and a 'qc' block (funnel, targets, ranked changes). Private repos are referenced by name only; no lead, contact, key or personal data is stored here.

systems.why_not: Not a system: a two-line Dockerfile (the public n8n image run as root) with no workflows, no tests and no data. Its Railway deployments were removed in May and July. The two n8n workflow files that exist live in the real-estate repo. Verdict: kill as an office; if n8n is wanted, run it as a shared service with a pinned image version and a non-root user.

in_repo.hq_wholesale.py: Jarvis's existing real-estate bridge (reads valuation candidates, writes AI valuations back). Dormant until WHOLESALE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY is set; it belongs to the realestate-ca office.
